question: _________ recommend(s) 20 mm wide margins for sheet sizes AO and A1 in engineering drawings.
solution:
The correct answer is __Borders and frames: SP: 46 (2003).__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Borders and frames: SP: 46 (2003)__ recommend 20 mm wide margins for sheet sizes A0 and A1 in engineering drawings.
 
• SP: 46 (2003) provides guidelines for technical drawing standards in engineering and design.
 
• The margins are essential to ensure clarity and avoid overlap with the content of the drawing.
 
• It also helps in maintaining uniformity and professional presentation across engineering drawings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Grid reference system:**

 
 
• It is used to locate points on a grid map.
 
• It is not related to setting margins for engineering drawings.
 
 
 
• **Custom grids:**
 
 
• Custom grids are user-defined grid systems for specific purposes.
 
• They do not prescribe margin standards for engineering drawings.
 
 
 
• **Geographic coordinate systems:**
 
 
• These systems define locations on Earth using latitude and longitude.
 
• They are not relevant to engineering drawing margins.
